result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with a faded zebra crosswalk and narrow sidewalks. The environment lacks modern pedestrian safety features such as curb ramps, clear signage, or daylighting at the corners to improve sightlines.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk
hazards.description: The zebra markings are significantly worn, making the crossing less visible to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: There are no visible sloped transitions from the sidewalk to the street, creating a barrier for people with mobility impairments.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner of the sidewalk on the right

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles close to the intersection may block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility continental markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile, sloped curb ramps at the crossing points to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the intersection to improve sightlines for all road users.
